confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from three web searches. One was for the RBA rate. One covered cost-of-living aggregates (Numbeo data via Expatica, Livingcost, Expatistan, My Life Elsewhere). One covered cocktail and wine prices (Square bar-pricing averages plus a few individual menus). Restaurant meal, coffee and beer prices agree well across sources. Cocktail prices come from Square averages of about $8-$10, and I adjusted them up slightly for restaurant and tourist-area pricing. I found no citywide average for wine by the glass. I set that figure from a handful of individual menus at $6-$10, plus the usual price relationship to beer and cocktails. The RBA figure is the 18 November 2026 observation, the latest found. The July 2026 pricing window was not checked separately. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge. I did not look at any booking pages or listings. They are the least certain figures, since hostel supply in San Antonio is thin and hotel rates swing with events and seasons. Prices are also taken before tax and tip.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-cost Texas and US Sun Belt city. Restaurant prices are close to Austin and Houston but slightly lower. Hotel rates are moderate and lean toward leisure and convention demand around the River Walk and the Alamo.
